explication: Advanced Damage System is a Farming Simulator 25 mod that replaces vanilla vehicle damage with usage-sensitive wear, breakdowns, thermal and electrical effects, and time-consuming service. The main player workflow is operating and inspecting vehicles, monitoring condition, then arranging workshop service before wear or failures disrupt work. The README also describes hand-tool maintenance, fleet and vehicle information, and multiplayer support. Source excerpts were unavailable, so module responsibilities and relationships beyond the documented capabilities are represented conservatively.
